other_conditions: Applicant must have at least Class VII level education.
Applicant must possess relevant skills, experience or knowledge to undertake income‑generating activities.
Preference is given to applicants who have completed Skill Development Training.
Applicant must not be a defaulter of any loan.
Applicants who were beneficiaries of the PMEGP scheme in the last five years are ineligible.
benefits_summary: Provides seed funding up to Rs 1 lakh for new entrepreneurs and up to Rs 2 lakh for existing entrepreneurs, with subsidies covering up to 20% of the loan amount.
